name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Latest global composite reading above 51; euro area and China surveys cooled in October
state: The J.P.Morgan global composite was well above 51 in September, and the October global composite had not been found as of 6 Nov (TrendForce data). October surveys show cooling: the euro-area composite fell to 51.7 and China's official composite to 49.7 (ActionForex; National Bureau of Statistics). No global reading near the 51 Watch line has been reported, so Normal holds.
for_you: Slowing activity surveys tend to precede softer hiring and trade. Exporters and commodity producers are most exposed if the global composite falls toward 50.
rubric_hit: Latest global composite > 51 (Normal); October regional surveys cooling
